messages.subject: Registration closes in seven days; introductory distance sampling training workshop
parts:
There are a few places remaining for the last introductory distance sampling training workshop of 2020.  ⏳ Workshop dates are 09-20 November 2020, but registration deadline is 23 October 2020. 📅

Complete details about the workshop content and a link to the registration site can be found at this link:

http://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-nov-2020.html

If you have any questions about the workshop, send them to me. 📩

-- 
Eric Rexstad
Centre for Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St Andrews
